newsitem.title: USA: Westin Hotels gets highest rating in J.D. Power study.
newsitem.headline: Westin Hotels gets highest rating in J.D. Power study.

text.p: Westin Hotels & Resorts was the highest ranked among the 11 major hotel chains in the first consumer study of the hotel industry, J.D. Power and Associates said Tuesday.
Business travelers rated more than 6,000 stays at upscale chains.
"Exceeding customer expectations and achieving higher degrees of loyalty are more important than ever," said Stephen C. Goodall, President of J.D. Power and Associates.
A major finding of the study is that 95 percent of those who rate their hotel experience at the highest "truly outstanding" level indicate they are "very likely to stay at that property again."

The upscale hotel chains ranking above average in the study were Westin Hotels & Resorts, followed by Renaissance Hotels and Resorts, Hyatt Hotels and Resorts, Marriott Hotels and Resorts and Omni Hotels.

Those chains ranking below industry average, in alphabetical order, were: Crowne Plaza, Doubletree Hotels, Hilton Hotels and Resorts, Sheraton Hotels and Resorts, Radisson Hospitality Worldwide and Red Lion Inns.
J.D. Power and Associates is an international marketing information firm.
